sources.text: Certified parish extract identifies the Vale burials, their named witnesses and the old ferry household, with an unbroken register custody chain.
Civil desk certifies a bounded search of the Vale birth/death names and household aliases in the final reconstruction rolls: no matching entries found.
Rivet burial-fund ledger records Vale household contributions and witnessed burial payments under the old ferry address.
Supervised transfer comparison finds labelled carriers matching parish inventory, but no civil identifiers in the receiving transfer schedule.
